Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 51 Enactment Date: 1988-09-24 Act Year: 1988 Short Title: The Labour Laws (Exemption from Furnishing Returns and Maintaining Registers by certain Establishments) Act, 1988 Long Title: An Act to provide for the exemption of employers in relation to establishments employing a small number of persons from furnishing returns and maintaining registers under certain labour laws. Department: Department of LABOUR Enforcement Date: 01-05-1989 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Labour and Employment, ) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 1st May, 1989, vide notification No. G.S.R. 436(E), dated 10th April, 1989, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
